item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description: v1.1.0 brings an entirely new and modern UI interface, along with a host of other new features. - Added glass UI across almost the entire app - Input fields - Buttons - Menus - Added smooth open and close menu animations - Added a new login/signup screen - New onboarding process - New settings screen - Customizable themes and colors - New memory screen - Support for BYOK with Gemini and Tavily - New message generation animation - Streaming support - Support for Photos via Camera, and Photos via Library - Basic support for opening chats while in other screens (UI upgrades to be added later) - Added plan-wise file upload limits - Nicer popup menus (to be turned into glass UI later) - Support for Interactions API (with interleaved tool calls) and tool UI - Proper error state handling and UI - Added Cairos Pages v1 - Added Cairos To-Do/Tasks v1 - Added top bar fade (and bottom fade in some places) - New API Plugins screen and API Tutorial screen - New file upload UI - Full screen nav bar - Added haptics on message received - Added a new and easy way to navigate through Cairos, a carousel - Stub screens for everything not built (hopefully everything atleast) - Search screen UI overhaul - New Update Available screen - Better light mode support - Switched to pure black in dark mode - New, dynamic time-aware greeting on chat screen - Support for a different default screen from chat - Faster launch time - Switched to Google Sans Flex and Google Sans in most of the app as the default font - Added new logo and wordmark - Added a better chat loading state - Full support for LaTeX and Markdown with gpt_markdown - New chat UI - Pill shaped message bubble - Better font size - Selectable text - Always visible copy, like, dislike and more buttons - Persistent file chips for files attached to messages - And other bug fixes and stability improvements
